title: 1620 Prairie's bay window stands as tall as its 1874 engraving
items: The bay window on 1620 Prairie's south front now rises to the engraving's heights: its two arched lights run up beside the principal-storey windows and its slated hood tucks under the window above.
The bay is painted timber, dark against the front as the engraving draws it (a liberty: the print cannot show its colour).
The bell-curved roof over the north pavilion, its arched dormer and the tall front chimney come down to where the engraving puts them.
